columns.wall_time_total_min / _h: total over the 20 applications; use minutes for Snyk Code (the paper prints 8 minutes) and hours for the others
columns.cost_status: known | unavailable | no per-scan model cost; cost cells are empty unless known, never 0
columns.tokens_per_matched_millions: empty for Snyk Code (no model tokens); compare within a provider family

units: hours, seconds, USD, millions of tokens, ratio
basis: main runs, single run per cell; DeepSec rows use localized-recall matches and are never compared with the others
derivation_note: Produced by the VulnBench 2.0 analysis pipeline, which verifies the archive's SHA-256, extracts it, and re-scores every run with a re-implementation of the public scorer that reproduces every recorded scoring decision; this file is a selection and renaming of the pipeline's output.
empty_cells: An empty cell means not applicable or unavailable; it never means zero.
